title: Normalized migration profile
description: The profile recommend-migration-path evaluates, after the interview has converted labels and prose into canonical IDs. reference/input-contract.md remains the prose authority; this file is the machine-checkable form of its section 4 canonical fields. It types the shape, not the full option vocabulary: the option IDs are already guarded by the interview-conforms-to-contract gate, and restating several hundred of them here would create a second copy to drift. Written in the JSON Schema subset implemented by tests/validate-scenarios.mjs.

scope.description: Drives the estate-discovery branch. When UNKNOWN the profile is treated as a single one and the estate branch does not fire.

source_location.description: Constrained to the IDs section 3 of reference/input-contract.md tabulates for this field, plus the three absence markers. It used to be a bare non-empty string, so a failed normalization such as "SQL Server 2037" or "fully managed" validated and reached the rules layer looking like a canonical profile. The enum is generated from the contract table rather than copied, and canonical-ids-match-the-contract fails the build if the two drift.

feature_dependencies.description: A list, not prose, so a rule can read a subtype such as PolyBase to an external RDBMS directly. An empty list is not the same as NONE_CONFIRMED: use the marker to record that the user checked.

size.description: Feeds the Hyperscale ceiling, the seeding strategy and tier selection. UNKNOWN holds the tier at unknown_requires_assessment rather than defaulting it.

downtime.description: The tolerance the business stated. Never inferred backwards from the method that was chosen.

compliance.description: Regional and sovereignty constraints. When UNKNOWN, sovereignty-restricted targets are not ranked first.

network_bandwidth.description: Constrained to the IDs reference/input-contract.md tabulates for this field, plus the absence markers. It used to be a bare non-empty string while advisor-fact-mappings.json mapped its exact values, so a plausible variant validated here and fell through to the crosswalk fallback: a port the user reported blocked stopped being a blocker.

network_ports.description: Legacy, superseded by network_bandwidth, mi_link_ports and blob_https_reachability. The mirror reads it as their union so scenarios written before the split still run. Not to be collected by a new interview.

performance.description: null means the question was asked and left unanswered, which is not the same as absent. When unresolved the tier becomes unknown_requires_assessment rather than defaulting to General Purpose.

database_count.description: Read against MI Link capacity: 100 links on General Purpose and Business Critical, 500 on Next-gen General Purpose.

migration_batch_size.description: Only evaluated when the Arc portal migration is used.

arc_extension_version.description: Never treated as recent when absent. The Arc wizard batch limit is 10 per batch from 1.1.3348.364 and 1 otherwise, so an unknown version yields unknown_requires_assessment.

feature_dependencies_state.description: Whether the dependency question was answered, and how. feature_dependencies is a list, and a list cannot say why it is empty: NONE_CONFIRMED means the user checked and found none, which clears a PaaS blocker, while UNKNOWN means blank, declined or unrecognised, which must hold the candidate at unknown_requires_assessment. The distinction was documented in the description of the list and enforced nowhere, so an unanswered question and a confirmed absence validated identically. ANSWERED means the list carries at least one dependency.

preview_acceptable.description: Whether the customer accepts a service or capability still in preview. Two indexed rules read it, MI-TIER for zone redundancy and COPILOT-AGENT for the control-plane branch, and the profile could not carry it: additionalProperties is false, so a decision those rules made could not be reproduced from a schema-valid input. UNKNOWN holds the preview option rather than granting it.

ancillary_services.description: SSIS, SSRS, SSAS, TDE, SQL Agent jobs, logins and the rest of what sits around the database. Question 12 collects it and the closed profile had nowhere to put it, so emitting the answer failed validation and omitting it dropped facts the remediation and the handoff both read.

ancillary_services_state.description: Why the ancillary list is empty, which the list itself cannot say. Same distinction as feature_dependencies_state: a confirmed absence clears remediation work, an unanswered question does not.

answer.description: A canonical option ID from reference/input-contract.md section 3, or one of the three absence markers. NONE_CONFIRMED means the user checked and there are none, and it clears a blocker. UNKNOWN means not checked, declined, blank or unrecognised, and it holds the candidate at unknown_requires_assessment. NOT_APPLICABLE means the question cannot apply to this profile. The distinction is the whole point: we have no linked servers clears a blocker, I have not looked at linked servers must not.

freeText.description: Recorded as written, never converted into a gate result. Free prose is context, not evidence.

evidence.description: Four self-reported booleans. They are recorded as claims to verify elsewhere and have no effect on the recommendation, because this skill reads no artefact. They once promoted a recommendation to validated and high, which turned an unverified statement into an assurance; that path no longer exists.

allOf.$comment: The state and the list cannot contradict each other.
A confirmed absence is an empty list, never a populated one.
